handoff.purpose: Complete official-source requirements for all 131 DHU Fall 2026 undergraduate, master's and doctoral routes.

unresolvedNotes: Scope covers official Fall 2026 routes with exact tuition, language thresholds and route-specific CSCA, supervision-intention or portfolio requirements where applicable.
This historical Fall 2026 cycle is closed and must not be shown as current.
The four scholarship records remain independent; no route-level entitlement is inferred.

sources.title: Donghua University 2026 bachelor's degree application guide
Donghua University 2026 bachelor's degree programs PDF

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen with a valid ordinary foreign passport and be in good physical and mental health.
Have sufficient financial resources and no criminal record.
Be at least 16 and under 25 for an entrance scholarship, or at least 16 and under 35 for self-funded study.
Hold a higher-secondary graduation certificate or international equivalent that qualifies the applicant for university entrance.
HSK5 above 180

references.locator: Application Eligibility and Language Proficiency Certificates

requirements.ruleText: Register in the DHU online application system, complete the form, upload all required materials, pay the non-refundable CNY 800 application fee and ensure the status is Submitted before the deadline. Only one major may be selected.
Upload the passport information page from an ordinary passport valid after February 1, 2027, plus applicable China visa and entry-stamp pages.

references.locator: Application Materials, Passport and Visa Pages

requirements.ruleText: Submit a certificate of no criminal conviction issued by the competent authority on or after November 1, 2025.

references.locator: Application Materials, Certificate of No Criminal Conviction

requirements.ruleText: Submit the DHU Statement of Financial Support signed by the applicant and financial guarantor on or after November 1, 2025; scholarship applicants must also document coverage beyond the scholarship scope.

references.locator: Application Materials, Statement of Financial Support

requirements.ruleText: Submit the scholarship-route documents specified by the guide, including the signed CSC form when applicable and the Foreigner Physical Examination Form with required reports; follow the DHU funding-source selection instructions.

references.locator: Additional or Mandatory Documents for Scholarship Applications

requirements.ruleText: Submit scholarship applications by April 15, 2026 and self-funded applications by May 31, 2026.
Participate in any language test, examination or interview arranged by DHU; the result forms part of the admission decision.

references.locator: Language Proficiency Certificates and program-specific assessment notes

requirements.ruleText: Present original academic and language documents for verification at registration and enrollment and satisfy any conditional-offer deadline.
Pay the published tuition for this route: CNY 24,000 per academic year.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants with specified Chinese nationality, parentage or secondary-education history
requirements.ruleText: Provide the foreign-passport, nationality, naturalization, Chinese-citizenship cancellation, parental-nationality and entry/exit evidence applicable to the circumstances described in the guide; the specified applicants must also satisfy the four-year nationality and two-year overseas-residence rules.

references.locator: Application Eligibility item 3 and Requirements for the following cases

requirements.ruleText: Upload the higher-secondary diploma or school-leaving certificate and complete transcripts with official stamps or signatures, grading-system explanation, and required translations and notarization. Pending graduates submit official pending proof and current transcripts, followed by final documents by the end of August 2026.
Submit the CSCA score report for the selected route. Required subjects: Chinese (Science), Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry (Chinese version).

references.locator: Application Materials item 4 and official 2026 program table

requirements.ruleText: Submit an approximately 1,000-word personal statement in the route's teaching language covering the guide's required background, motivation, experience and study or career planning details.
Submit a personal resume in the route's teaching language with personal, education, activity, competition, internship, practical-experience, honor, award and competency details as applicable.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants to art or design routes only
requirements.ruleText: No portfolio is published for this route; the art-portfolio rule applies only to the art and design routes named in the guide and program table.

references.locator: Mandatory for application of art design related programs

requirements.ruleText: Submit the DHU Guarantee Statement completed and signed by a legal adult guardian living in mainland China.

references.locator: Requirements for the following cases, item 1
